title: Field pairing density
statement: Let $d,\ell$ be natural numbers with $\ell\ne0$, and for each element $r$ of the binary extension field of degree $\ell$, let $a(r)$ be a length-$d$ list of elements of that field. Define a probability density on the binary cube of dimension $d$ by the uniform pushforward of the field pairing generator applied to a uniformly chosen pair $(r,s)$ of field elements, using $a(r)$ and $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ maps each field element to a length-$d$ list of field elements
